description: This file defines a test double (spy) class for CalendarSyncJobCleaner used in unit testing. It replaces database interactions with in-memory tracking of cancellations, providing methods to simulate, verify, and reset job cancellation behavior during tests.

classes.name: FakeCalendarSyncJobCleaner
classes.description: A test double class that tracks job cancellations in-memory for testing purposes, replacing real database operations.

methods.name: cancelPendingMeetingJobs
methods.description: Records the cancellation attempt of a calendar sync operation and returns a configurable number of jobs to cancel.

methods.name: setJobsToCancel
methods.description: Sets how many jobs should be reported as cancelled when cancelPendingMeetingJobs is called.

methods.name: wasCancelCalled
methods.description: Checks if any cancellation has been recorded.

methods.name: getCancelledOperations
methods.description: Returns an array of all recorded cancelled operations.

methods.name: getCancellationCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of cancellation attempts recorded.

methods.name: getLastCancelledOperation
methods.description: Retrieves the most recently recorded cancellation operation.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the in-memory record of cancellations and the configured number of jobs to cancel.
